item.title: .NET and C# Notes — Falling Back from async/await, C++ DLL Marshalling, Saving a WPF Control as PNG
item.description: Notes from building a Windows app in 2015: writing it with async/await on .NET 4.5.2 and then rewriting for 4.0 because the target PCs lacked the runtime, passing LPCTSTR from C# into a C++ DLL, and rendering a WPF control to PNG.
